newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: North and South Korea exchange fire at border.
newsitem.headline: North and South Korea exchange fire at border.

text.p: North and South Korean soldiers exchanged fire at the Korean border on Wednesday, a South Korean defence ministry official said.
"There was an exchange of fire between South and North Korean soldiers in the Demilitarized Zone today but I don't have any more details," said the official, who declined to be identified.

Yonhap Television News said shooting broke out after five North Korean soldiers crossed the Military Demarcation Line, which runs midway through the four-km (2.5-mile) wide DMZ that bisects the Korean peninsula.

Yonhap said the soldiers were first spotted at 10.50 a.m. (0150 GMT). They ignored repeated broadcast warnings and began shooting at a southern guard post. South Korean troops in the guard post returned the fire.
There were no reports of injuries.
